evidence.observation: Smooth monotonic heat-up with vapor front progressing up the column; T712 now rising (87 °C), consistent with column reaching the top
Reflux and distillate flows low and noisy; FT703 briefly dropped to 0.005 at k=19 then recovered, FT704 declining toward ~0.01 L/h
System pressure stepped from ~649 to ~633-637 mbar at k=19-20
Differential pressures steady ~0.8-1.2 and ~1.9 mbar, no flooding or blockage signature

args.missing_evidence: Distillate composition (GC) measurement, and confirmation whether the PY23 pressure step and near-zero FT704 are a commanded setpoint change/takeoff start or an unintended leak/flow fault
